_comment: Full counting statistics of a double quantum dot, the configuration of the upstream test test_dqd_current in code/qutip/qutip/tests/solver/test_countstat.py. Three-level system (empty, left, right); H = eps/2*sz + tc*sx swept over eps; sequential tunnelling through both leads as collapse operators; current and zero-frequency noise from countstat_current_noise. The three levels are the physical model and are not a truncation, so the workload knob is the bias sweep, not a Hilbert dimension.
